title: Reacting to signals
hints: Supervise handles one signal and returns, so a second SIGHUP has nobody listening. It needs a loop.

for sig := range sigs { ... } keeps receiving until the channel is closed. In the loop, SIGHUP calls reload and keeps going, while os.Interrupt or syscall.SIGTERM calls shutdown and returns the signal.
Ignore any other signal. If the channel is closed, return nil without calling shutdown.
